attempts.summary: Configured node1 as the persistent internal DNS resolver and node2 to use it. inventory-api.internal resolves to node2 (10.100.93.11), while public DNS forwarding remains functional. Both nodes retained AlmaLinux 9.6 and kernel 5.14.0-570.12.1.el9_6.x86_64. One startup-order issue discovered during node1’s first restart was corrected with dynamic interface binding; the final restart sequence passed on both nodes.
